'''Leonid Ivanovich Bodnarchuk''' ({{langx|ru|Леонид Иванович Боднарчук}}; 13 January 1938 – 24 March 2015) was a Ukrainian scientist, Correspondent Member of the [[:ru:Национальная академия аграрных наук Украины|National Academy of Agrarian Sciences of Ukraine]] since 1999.
From 1989 to 2012, he was Director of the Ukrainian Research Institute of Apiculture "[[:ru:Институт пчеловодства им. П. И. Прокоповича|P.I. Prokopovych Institute of beekeeping]]". In 1997 he received the title of Professor.

He graduated from the [[National University of Life and Environmental Sciences of Ukraine]] in 1961.

In 1974, Bodnarchuk defended his dissertation and earned the degree of [[Candidate of Sciences|Candidate of Biological Sciences]] in 1975.

From 1974 to 1989 he work at the [[I. I. Schmalhausen Institute of Zoology]].

Since 1997 he was a professor at his alma mater.

Professor Bodnarchuk is the author of 10 monographs and more than 350 articles. He is the author of works about apitherapy.

He was awarded:
* [[Order of Merit (Ukraine)|Order of Merit]], three times, 1st, 2nd and 3rd classes (2003, 2008, 2009)
* [[Medal "Veteran of Labour"]] (1987)
* Honored Man of agriculture of the Ukraine (1998)
